q3_10q.limitation: 10-Q does not disaggregate exercised/remaining counts by public versus sponsor warrant class; no post-November-9 exercise count was verified

public_warrant_prospectus.issuer_proceeds_rule: company receives proceeds only when public warrants are exercised; not from resale of shares under the prospectus
public_warrant_prospectus.interpretation: the 11,499,992 figure is the public-warrant registration ceiling, not the current remaining total after the 10-Q reports 3,073,366 exercises

sponsor_warrant_prospectus.issuer_proceeds_rule: no proceeds from selling securityholders' resale; proceeds only if sponsor warrants are exercised for cash
sponsor_warrant_prospectus.interpretation: public-warrant count plus sponsor-warrant count equals 11,739,645 total warrants assumed at closing

equity_line.interpretation: share capacity and commitment fee are not capital raised; no ELOC proceeds are counted without a disclosed draw

exact_phrase_research.result: no separate token/company/issuer identity established; secondary coverage uses the phrase generically for financing and warrant capacity
exact_phrase_research.controlling_evidence: SEC issuer filings distinguish actual cash proceeds, non-cash XRP contributions, debt, exercised warrants, remaining warrants and ELOC capacity

source_independence.reason: all three controlling warrant documents are primary Evernorth SEC issuer filings; they are distinct filings but not independent publishers

disconfirming_evidence_and_limits: The 10-Q's 8,666,279 remaining warrants are a total across classes; the filing does not disclose the remaining public/sponsor split.
The $99.662M remaining theoretical amount assumes every remaining warrant is exercised for cash at $11.50.
No exercise proceeds after 2026-11-09 were verified.
The $132.250M original public-warrant ceiling must not be represented as current remaining proceeds.
The ELOC capacity and SBI investment in Circle are separate from XRP cash purchases.
